verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say Devin Review with Auto-Fix lets Devin automatically respond to review comments, fix flagged bugs and iterate on CI failures, so it covers the core idea of diagnosing and fixing CI breaks. That evidence is a single line, though, and describes iterating on CI within existing PRs, not watching failed workflows and opening a new proposed PR. The API could be used to wire up such a trigger, but only with custom integration work. Missing for 10: documented automatic triggering on failed CI workflows, explicit generation of a new fix PR from a CI failure, in-depth docs of the CI diagnosis flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
